title: My Son-In-Law Forged My Signature And Sold Our Company For $750K. So I Let The Court Handle It.
description: After my son-in-law drained my $100K retirement fund to start a tiny-home company, he forged my release, sold it for $750,000, and tossed me a $6,000 ‘settlement.’ I found a time-stamped video of our original handshake deal that proved the forgery, won back the business and the model home, and now he works off his debt in a pink ‘Built on Deceit’ shirt while I run Small Lies Tiny Homes. #TinyHome #Fraud #JusticeServed
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY RELEASE AND STOLE MY COMPANY
pinned_comment: If your son-in-law drained your $100K retirement, forged your release to sell your tiny-home company for $750K, and left you with a $6K insult, would you have fought back in court and made him wear a ‘Built on Deceit’ shirt, or walked away? Share your story below.
